name: Gondolin Sandbox
description: Local disposable micro-VM: 2 CPUs, 4 GiB RAM, 20 GiB writable root disk. Copies the requested committed state; no host mounts or credential forwarding. Includes the adapter; click Prepare Runtime in Gondolin Settings once after installation. Requires host Git, OpenSSH tools and QEMU.
create: test -x "$HOME/.local/share/orca-gondolin/bin/orca-gondolin" || { printf '%s\n' 'Gondolin runtime is not prepared. Open Gondolin Settings and click Prepare Runtime.' >&2; exit 1; }; "$HOME/.local/share/orca-gondolin/bin/orca-gondolin" create
destroy: test -x "$HOME/.local/share/orca-gondolin/bin/orca-gondolin" || { printf '%s\n' 'Gondolin runtime is not prepared. Open Gondolin Settings and click Prepare Runtime before retrying destroy.' >&2; exit 1; }; "$HOME/.local/share/orca-gondolin/bin/orca-gondolin" destroy
